games.name: Anomalous Cleaning Detail
games.summary: A first-person cleaning simulator where you scrub, vacuum, and restore a troubled town plagued by supernatural disturbances. Complete contracts and use environmental clues to prepare for the exorcism, because when the mess is paranormal, a standard clean won't be enough.

games.name: Anomalous Veil
games.summary: Anomalous Veil is a psychological horror experience that can be completed in 30–90 minutes and features branching endings.

games.name: BeBalance
games.summary: Balance brooms, reeds, feather dusters, and one deeply uncooperative crowbar on a single fingertip. Chase the center of mass, survive crosswinds and parrots, earn coins, unlock skills, and consider an important question: is staying upright really more impressive than being caught?

games.name: Black Hollow
games.summary: Black Hollow is a dark fantasy roguelite FPS where you play as a lone plague doctor defending a remote farmstead from waves of plague-stricken villagers. Fight through the night with your staff, lantern, and unstable plague mixtures, then use the remains of the infected to unlock new attacks, potions, and upgrades at an ancient runestone.

games.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

games.name: Bravery
games.summary: BRAVERY is a third-person 3D adventure game in which players guide a fragile matchstick character through vast, detailed environments that appear enormous in scale. Gameplay focuses on exploration, tense chase sequences, and interactive fire mechanics that allow objects to be ignited. Throughout the journey, players discover hidden areas and capture enigmatic orbs that are sealed within restored magical mirrors, shaping progression through the world.

games.name: Bureaucromancer
games.summary: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

games.name: Calvar: The Darkest Gate
games.summary: First-person horror survival game that plunges players into a dark and disturbing world. As Leonard Valentin, you must fight against supernatural threats while uncovering the mystery behind the cursed piano and the sinister plans of a dark cult.

games.name: Castle Wars: Legacy
games.summary: Strategy card game where you need to crush enemy caste or raise yours by playing the right cards. With 3 types of cards, build, attack and magic players need to balance their resources and manage castle and wall better than the opponent in order to win. This is version of castle wars has both single player mode for playing campaign levels or vs the AI and multiplayer and advanced multiplayer mode in daily tournaments.

games.name: Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
games.summary: Tower Defense + Auto Chess + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

games.name: Coal Duty
games.summary: 1-5 Player Co-op Extraction Horror. Under a frozen sky and an iron-fisted regime, you work to survive by descending into forbidden depths, scavenging resources, and paying off your state-imposed debt.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.name: Corinne
games.summary: Navigate Corinne through a realm of pixel horrors, surrounded by neighbors that are turning into bloodthirsty monsters. Discover the secrets of this twisted dimension before it's too late for Corinne and her friends.

games.name: Crow's Curated Closet: Shop Simulator
games.summary: Step into the role of a boutique owner with a flair for the unusual. Decorate your shop, unlock new collections, and create a space your customers won’t want to leave. Grow your business, optimise your layout, and watch the numbers climb. Turn your tiny shop into a thriving gothic fashion powerhouse

games.name: D-Extinction
games.summary: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

games.name: Danchi Days
games.summary:
Help Hoshino bring her hometown back together in a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in 2000s Japan! She'll face malevolent forces, uncover truths about her town, all while reconnecting with neighbors and her grandma living with dementia.

By gingham games - that's sandy powder, mogumu, and Melos Han-Tani (of Analgesic Productions)!

games.name: Dancing Wings: The Aerobatic Simulator
games.summary: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

games.name: Dawn of Irkalla
games.summary: Dawn of Irkalla is a 4 player co-op horror stealth dungeon-crawler where you have no weapons and no way to fight back. Build your deck, unlock skills, scavenge vital items, and race against the clock to retrieve artifacts for a shadowy government agency. Your survival depends on it.

games.name: DayZ: Badlands
games.summary: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

games.name: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
games.summary: Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play, swift reflexes, and exploration as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell"

games.name: Don't Fret
games.summary: Don't! Fret is stylized first-person psychological mascot-horror game set in a musically themed world. Play as a guitar named Fret to solve puzzles, escape from foes, and uncover the mystery behind Harmonic Heights.

games.name: Down Pit
games.summary: Dig. And Get Paid.

games.name: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered
games.summary: A striking modern revival of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3" and "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends," which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Aim for the peak of 1 vs 1,000 action in this even more enjoyable and thrilling revival.

games.name: End of Abyss
games.summary: Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility's derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

games.name: False Hero
games.summary: False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos. Explore the corrupted Land of the Gods and put your combat skills to the true test in challenging boss fights. Will you fight for the Gods or become an apostle of Death?

games.name: Faybound: Veils of Magic
games.summary: An ancient darkness threatens the balance of a magical world. Take on the roles of different fairies and unite their powers. Use their unique abilities to confront the emerging threat. Experience a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania full of danger and mystical secrets.

games.name: Fiefdom
games.summary: Change the world, one battle at a time in FIEFDOM: a multiplayer action melee game set in a playerbase-driven story. Clash swords, cast spells, rain down arrows & more in in battles of up to 100 players both at land & at sea. Dive into a world where your victories define the outcome of entire wars. Who will you be fighting for?

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
games.summary: The Gear.Club series is back! Customize and set up your favourite cars to race at top speed along the roads of the French Mediterranean coast and Japan. Don't just win – show off your style!

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​
Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​
Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: Goldfish Simulator
games.summary: Goldfish Simulator: “Endless Move” is a meditative idle goldfish simulation game. The goldfish react as if they were alive, and their movements are realistic and elegant.

games.name: Hauntasy
games.summary: Do you believe in ghosts? A wealthy baron offers you $1,000,000 to take part in the Hauntasy, a seven-night challenge inside his family's supposedly haunted estate. Keep watch, manage your limited resources, and survive until dawn to claim the reward.

games.name: Havoc Heirs
games.summary: A fantasy turn-based RPG in a massive interconnected world. Monsters are everywhere, and you may end up being one of them.

games.name: Hex Tower Boogie
games.summary: Hex Tower Boogie is a tower defense game combined with factory-style automation, played on a hexagonal grid. Players build conveyor belts, splitters and mergers to route ammunition to their towers; towers only fire when supplied by the production line. It mixes logistics and supply-chain management with wave-based defense. Developed with the Godot engine.

games.name: Hollow Faces
games.summary: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

games.name: How to Destroy a City
games.summary: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

games.name: If You Stay
games.summary: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

games.name: Keep Watering
games.summary: Keep Watering is an incremental game with a cozy, hypnotic loop where every drop of water grows into something extraordinary.

games.name: Kitty Found a Camera
games.summary: A First-and-Third-Person Photo Shooter (FATPPS) where you take photos to solve problems and get into mischief.

games.name: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
games.summary: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

games.name: Let's Tidy Up!: Konbini
games.summary: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. Completing shelves unlocks new skills and abilities that you can use to help you stack over 5000 unique items as quickly as possible!

games.name: Let's Tidy Up!: Treasure
games.summary: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room after a particularly lucrative year. Complete full shelves to unlock skills and abilities. Sort, stack and shelve 8,888 unique items as you slowly unravel the secrets beneath...

games.name: MXGP 26: The Official Game
games.summary: Dominate the track, feel every impact, every rut, every victory. The most intense and realistic motocross experience is finally available. Experience the entire 2026 championship, with its official tracks and riders.

games.name: Mystic Land: The search for Maphaldo
games.summary: An old-school RPG game inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

games.name: Neverway
games.summary: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

games.name: No Rest for the Wicked
games.summary: From Moon Studios, the award-winning developers of Ori and the Blind Forest and Ori and the Will of the Wisps comes No Rest for the Wicked, a visceral, precision Action RPG set to reinvent the genre.

games.name: No Return Address
games.summary: Night shift at a distribution center. Ordinary packages go forward, strange ones go to reject. Just dont make a mistake when the boxes start containing things that should never be there.

games.name: No Service
games.summary: Uncover, experience, and survive service. Tasked with exploring and reporting any wrongdoing, you are the last train inspector on shift. descend into madness as this surreal comedy sonders your psyche.

games.name: No Witnesses
games.summary: No Witnesses is a 2-16 player party game. Play online or with your friends. Somebody in this lobby is a Killer. Nobody saw it happen. Killers hide in the crowd, Bystanders scramble to survive and a Detective works the forensics - while buffs and debuffs drag every round into chaos. Trust no one.

games.name: Not Monsters
games.summary: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

games.name: Oathwood Realms
games.summary: Oathwood Realms is a dark fantasy strategy card game focused on careful planning, tactical decisions, and calculated risk. Luck plays a role, but victory favors players who read the board and commit to their choices.

games.name: Occult Hand of the Blood Lily
games.summary: A Gothic-Punk yuri visual novel about a magician on the run and her mysterious vampiric guardian. Journey by airship across a war-torn Europe and search for a legendary flower with the power to destroy nations.

games.name: Octopath Traveler
games.summary: A role-playing game from the Bravely Default team is being developed exclusively for the Nintendo Switch. They have brought a new world to life through a mix of CG, pixel art, and "HD-2D" visuals.

games.name: Octopath Traveler II
games.summary:
This game is a brand-new entry in the Octopath Traveler series. It takes the series’ HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG, to even greater heights.
In the world of Solistia, eight new travelers venture forth into an exciting new era.
Where will you go? What will you do? Whose tale will you bring to life?
Every path is yours to take. Embark on an adventure all your own.

games.name: Ominous Recall
games.summary: Ominous Recall: A chilling survival horror game set in a photorealistic Middle East. Confront a terrifying Jinn possessing Stephen and unravel its dark power in this intense psychological thriller.

games.name: Penguin Weapons
games.summary: Penguin Weapons is a dynamic action roguelite about penguins that collect artifacts, creating absurdly crazy weapons, fight monsters and bosses, unlock stylish clothes, and explore increasingly difficult worlds full of unique combinations and unpredictability alone or with friends.

games.name: Prophet Margin
games.summary: Turn humble villages into a thriving network of trade and prosperity to satisfy the gods. Inspired by Euro board games, Prophet Margin is a thinky city-building puzzler where every road, resource, and connection creates new opportunities. Can you maximize the profits and please the gods?

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
games.summary:
When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream.

Enjoy Rayman Origins like never before with 4K resolution, 60 FPS, and modern enhancements, including new quality-of-life features. Discover 60 hidden Relics across the adventure and track your progress in the Snoring Tree.

games.name: Red Chat Ritual: Tsumimi Time
games.summary: An idol livestreamer is searching for her missing partner. You are not just watching her stream. Interfere with her broadcast, investigate clues on and off stream, and uncover the truth behind her partner’s disappearance.

games.name: Reversi2048
games.summary: Reversi meets 2048. Every time a piece is flipped, its score doubles. Having more pieces isn't enough if your opponent's total score is higher, you lose. A fresh take on a classic strategy game.

games.name: Sanasana
games.summary: To bring her deceased sister back to life, a young girl sets out to steal the Golden Apples from three witches. Dodge beautiful yet merciless bullet patterns in this dark fantasy bullet hell shooter filled with madness.

games.name: Shady Business
games.summary: Make lamps for villains! As a Villux employee, you create eclectic lamps for ominous clients of the underworld. Receive your design brief, build your lamp, and shape the sinister plans of your customers across a treacherous network of villains.

games.name: Spline: Part One
games.summary: A narrative-driven psychological horror game in which a man searching for his missing wife becomes trapped within a distorted reality known as the Spline, navigating hostile environments, persistent threats, and fragmented clues that reveal the nature of the world around him.

games.name: Spooky Market
games.summary: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

games.name: Steel Ark
games.summary: A first-person survival sandbox game where you explore a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge resources, craft production chains, and keep your train base running against all odds.

games.name: The Gastarbeiters
games.summary: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Raise a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

games.name: The Legend of Chalkvania
games.summary: A bite-sized retro action-adventure set in a quirky, cursed land. Fight monsters, meet strange characters, and uncover hidden secrets in this fast-paced homage to classic 2D side-scrollers. Choose your path—embrace the light or the curse. Your legend begins in Chalkvania.

games.name: Tile & Error
games.summary: A word-game roguelite. Place words to crack escalating score targets, enchant single tiles until they detonate, freeze or pay gold, and tilt the whole board when nothing fits. Bosses rewrite the rules, the shop rebuilds your bag, and every run digs deeper into the alphabet.

games.name: Umbral Coterie
games.summary: A dark city simulation with procedural generation and emergent storytelling. Observe, befriend, manipulate, and betray hundreds of fully simulated citizens as they live, work, scheme, and die around you. Shape bloodlines across generations and uncover the sinister forces moving beneath the city.

games.name: Under the Red Sky
games.summary: Under The Red Sky is a 3D parkour game where speed is king! Your goal is to get to the end of each level as quick as possible by taking one of the many different routes possible, or by finding your own. Watch out though, this isn't all fun and games. You may accidentally fall into the past and uncover dark secrets, slowly deciphering the hidden propaganda behind it all and how to get back above. As you look up, you may find that you're Under the Red Sky.

games.name: Unending Aqua
games.summary: Explore a mysterious tropical island resort. Collect items and solve puzzles to progress. Survive against dangerous enemies. Piece together the story of the hotel and uncover the dark secrets that it holds.

games.name: Usagi Shima
games.summary: Usagi Shima is a relaxing, idle bunny collecting game. You’ve been tasked as caretaker of an abandoned island — as you decorate it over time, curious (but adorable!) bunny visitors start to appear! Buy toys, plants, and build structures on an abandoned island to entice curious bun tourists to pay your island a visit. Discover, take photos, and make friends with a variety of bunnies that visit based on how you’ve decorated and arranged the island.

games.name: Vertigo Enigma
games.summary: Congratulations! You have been chosen for Vertigo Enigma. A narrative puzzle experiment where your logic and observation are the test. Until it glitches. Until you understand what "chosen" means...

games.name: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War
games.summary: The sixth installment in the Ace Combat series explores the Belkan War, a devastating conflict alluded to in Ace Combat 5. In the game's main story mode, the player takes control of a mercenary pilot, callsign "Cipher", taking part in the Belkan War by advancing through aerial combat, escort, assault, and defense missions. The story is told through the eyes of a reporter, 10 years after the conflict, uncovering secrets of the war by interviewing some of the pilots the player shoots down.

games.name: Bering Tonnage
games.summary: Build and automate a cargo fleet across over 250 real-world ports in this maritime tycoon. Route ships through strategic canals, navigate tropical cyclones and geopolitical sanctions, and grow a small shipping company into a global logistics empire.

games.name: Bloodspill
games.summary: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, pvp retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest!

games.name: The False Alice: Retold Tale
games.summary: A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice gacha game. It will features a new scenario and new CGs, backgrounds, BGM, character facial expressions and pose differences.

games.name: FAFO Executive Order Simulator
games.summary: F around and find out! A ruthless no F's given dark comedy where you play the president of the United States of America, abuse executive power, crank up the FAFO meter, deal with robot overlords, alien invasions, drain swamps, flip off allies, crush protests, and destroy all that oppose you!

games.name: Pedal Rebel VR
games.summary: Pedal Rebel VR is a adrenaline-pumping cyberpunk motorbike street racing game that completely transforms any exercise bike and any VR headset into an immersive racing experience!

games.name: Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
games.summary: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis
games.summary:
Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis is a mobile game covering the whole FFVII timeline by splitting each story into short chapters focused on important moments using animated cutscenes, some with conversation options, followed by a battle.

Relive the most memorable moments from FFVII and experience the journey of a young hero Sephiroth.

Experience both classic and new stories within the FFVII universe presented in a retro-style look combined with modern, beautifully rendered graphics, that’s easily accessible on the go. Team up your favorite characters and customize each one with iconic gear and weapons to defeat powerful opponents in Solo or Co-op battle mode.

games.name: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
games.summary: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Boku to Tsuri Nikki
games.summary: Boku to Tsuri Nikki is a freshwater fishing game set in a peaceful, nature-filled world, where players can enjoy an immersive fishing experience.

games.name: Calx
games.summary: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

games.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.summary: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5
games.summary: Stand and fight for humanity. This arcade shooter takes place in the year 2022, as the Earth Defense Force fends off an all-out attack by unknown life forms. Become an EDF soldier, battle against endless hordes of immense enemies, and restore peace to the earth.

games.name: Echo Weaver
games.summary: A fast-paced metroidBRAINia that tells the tale of a ruined society trapped in a fatal time loop. Uncover their story - and your own - as you explore what remains. Use each loop to chip away at the mystery, unlocking powerful knowledge to reshape the timeline and master the loop.

games.name: Forever Ago
games.summary: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting people, and even make some new friends.

games.name: Harold Rabbit 3: The House of Mysteries
games.summary: Harold Rabbit and Maud Bumblebee have been invited to the mansion of Archibald Squirrel, for a great game of wits. Can Harold and Maud solve the riddles and puzzles Archibald Squirrel has prepared for them?

games.name: Kingdom Hearts 0.2: Birth by Sleep - A Fragmentary Passage
games.summary: A short sequel to Kingdom Hearts Birth By Sleep that partially takes place during the events of the first Kingdom Hearts, A fragmentary passage gets its name from a hidden ending to BBS and tells the story of Master Aqua's ten-year journey through the Realm of Darkness. 0.2 acts as a prologue to the upcoming Kingdom Hearts III, and also as a demo of Kingdom Hearts traversal, combat, and graphics in Unreal Engine 4 as it will appear in KH3. This game is only playable as part of the collection Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix
games.summary: Originally released exclusively in Japan. An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix was finally released globally for the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX."

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD is a full HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance designed for the PlayStation 4. It was released as part of a package of three games entitled Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.

The game is largely the same as its Nintendo 3DS counterpart, but includes some additional features as well as alterations designed to adapt the game to the PS4. The conversion from two screens to one is the most notable of the changes seen. Little has changed in terms of gameplay. However, three new Dream Eaters have been introduced and minor game features have been altered to adapt to the PS4.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Final Mix
games.summary: Originally released only in Japan on December 26, 2002, Kingdom Hearts Final Mix is finally brought to the global scene as an HD Remaster in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". It has several events and a number of gameplay tweaks that are not in previous releases. New scenes, clarifying certain plot points, such as Riku's journey and foreshadowing of Kingdom Hearts II, were included, but no new dialogue was recorded. A gameplay option allows the player to skip cutscenes. The optional bosses are included, along with a new fight against "Unknown Man."

games.name: Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix
games.summary: An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix, which was originally exclusive to Japan. It was released globally for the first time as part of the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX".

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts III is the third main installment in the Kingdom Hearts series developed and published by Square Enix. It was initially released January 2019 for the PlayStation 4 and the Xbox One. An expansion, Kingdom Hearts III Re Mind was released in January 2020.

The story takes place after the events of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance. It features an older Sora as the main protagonist, who sets forth on a new adventure to search for seven guardians of light in an attempt to stop Xehanort from bringing about a second Keyblade War. Sora is joined by Donald Duck, Goofy, Mickey Mouse, Riku, Kairi, and others. Along the way, Sora travels to many worlds from Disney and Pixar intellectual properties, and cross paths with the real Organization XIII.

Kingdom Hearts III features hack and slash combat reminiscent of Kingdom Hearts II, with elements from later handheld entries, allowing the player to control Sora in a party with Donald, Goofy, and up to two other Disney characters from the various worlds he visits. A major addition compared is the Formchange mechanic, which allows his currently equipped Keyblade to grant him special abilities and change shape. Sora can equip up to three Keyblades at a time, and cycle between them to use his abilities. Another addition is the Attractions mechanic, which occasionally allows Sora to summon and pilot a vehicle inspired by Disney theme park attractions. At certain points throughout the game, the player will be able to control other characters.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III: Re Mind
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts III: Re Mind is a downloadable expansion to Kingdom Hearts III, released in 2020. Set during and after the game’s climax, it adds new story scenarios (“Re Mind,” “Limitcut Episode,” and “Secret Episode”), challenging boss battles, and extended lore connections. Two editions were made available, with the deluxe version including a recording of the Kingdom Hearts Orchestra -World of Tres- concert. A free patch released alongside the DLC also added the Oathkeeper and Oblivion Keyblades.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories is a full remake of Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories, originally released on the Game Boy Advance. It was originally remade for the PS2, and eventually remastered in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". The game was also changed in that completing the "Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days" cutscenes would unlock additional Enemy Cards that would have been unlocked in the original by having save data from "Kingdom Hearts II: Final Mix"

games.name: Once Upon a Katamari
games.summary: Keep the good times rolling with a new entry in the Katamari Damacy series! In this puzzle action-adventure game, you'll roll your Katamari through time itself. Journey through the Jurassic Period, Ice Age, historic Japan, and more eras to rebuild the starry sky.

games.name: PlantUp
games.summary: Grow plants, process your harvest, and serve impatient customers before chaos takes over your shop. PlantUp blends cozy farming with fast-paced time management, clever upgrades, and a campaign full of challenges.

games.name: Rainbow Islands CS
games.summary: Experience 6 different versions of the magical world of Rainbow Islands! That comical place full of dreams is back!

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: The Crew: Motorfest
games.summary: The Crew Motorfest is an open-world racing game set on scaled-down versions of the Hawaiian islands of Oahu and Maui. The third entry in The Crew series, it is structured around a festival theme with "Playlists" consisting of staged races, side activities, and challenges built around topics like specific car brands or motorsport disciplines. Players can control cars, boats, and planes across the open world, and multiplayer modes include the Grand Race and Demolition Royale. The game originally started development as DLC for The Crew 2 before becoming a standalone title, and draws comparisons to the Forza Horizon series for its festival-based structure.

games.name: Beat, Heart, Beat
games.summary: Beat, Heart, Beat is an autoscrolling rhythm-platformer centered around slashing through enemies to the music to maintain your momentum and traverse your way towards your own heart. There are three directions to slash - up, down and right in front of you. Slash in the correct direction to aim your attacks at enemies and dash into them. Performing a series of slashes to the correct rhythmic pattern is the key to reaching the end of the stage and advancing onwards to your heart.

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more.

On your journey, you’ll be joined by Pawns, mysterious otherworldly beings, in an adventure so unique you will feel as if accompanied by other players while on your own adventure.

All of these elements are elevated further by the latest in graphics, artificial intelligence (AI) and physics technology to create a truly immersive fantasy world in Dragon's Dogma 2.

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Based on feedback we received after the initial release of Dragon's Dogma 2, we established three goals for ourselves when we set out to update and expand the game:
Enhanced gameplay. Expanded adventures. Enticing value.

games.name: Horse Club Ride West
games.summary: Travel to the Wild River Ranch and experience exciting adventures.

games.name: Lights Out, Run
games.summary: A first-person survival horror game where you must cross your house at night while the fears of your childhood become real.

games.name: Paperhead
games.summary:
PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced FPS game set in a world where everything is made out of cardboard and paper but is infested with horror!
Use a pencil as a weapon and explore what exactly went wrong in the secret research facility and why suddenly papercut people were able to...bleed.
Paperhead's Main Features

- Cardboard cute style with a horror twist. Cute but horrifying!

- Brutal and fast-paced combat. Slide to throw enemies in the air, kick explosive barrels into them (or enemies themselves!), and jump onto them Mario-style.

- Use a Pencil as a weapon. Draw a bomb to explode enemies!

- Use a Pencil as a reality-warping puzzle-solving tool. Not sure how to get through? Try to draw a door on the wall!

WHY WOULD PAPER...BLEED?

games.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
games.summary: Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow. There’s so much to do with Elmo and your Sesame Steet friends. Enjoy exploring their world, growing beanstalks, cooking tasty food, and helping your new friends throw a big party for the neighborhood.

games.name: The Hat Man
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game inspired by The Hat Man urban legend, focusing on sleep paralysis, fear, and the terror of being unable to move.

games.name: True Love For Her
games.summary: True Love For Her (TLFH) is a Yandere game inspired by Yandere Simulator and Life Is Strange that doesn’t compete with the original games. This game involves murder and other methods of killing, so it is not suitable for kids. We are not responsible for any actions taken by kids replicating activities from TLFH in real life.

games.name: Star Conflict
games.summary: Star Conflict is a Free to Play online space combat game featuring multiple Objective-Based Team Gameplay modes, three main factions with 2 respective sub factions each, and an array of ship customization and three types of ships complete with there own ship tree and skill tree.

games.name: Alien Archeologist
games.summary: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

games.name: Ghostpunk
games.summary: Investigate paranormal cases using a 1990s CRT terminal. Analyze photos. Decode audio. Interrogate suspects and decide what’s real, what’s fake and who’s lying. But the deeper you go, the more the system starts watching you back.

games.name: Allogloom
games.summary: Chaos has descended upon the town of Gruesome Grove and its fate rests in Nora’s hands. Join her on an oftentimes gory journey through a beautifully hand-drawn world. Discover forgotten truths, make peculiar friends, encounter monsters and solve puzzles in this mysterious and macabre adventure.

games.name: Attic Antiquities
games.summary: Precious dolls haunted by evil spirits have appeared on your doorstep. Use the tools of the Beaufort Family Workshop to exorcise them and learn why they've come to you.

games.name: Planet Zoo 2
games.summary: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.summary: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.summary: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Cutout Village
games.summary: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!

games.name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
games.summary: Run the logistics center of the future! Hire robots, deliver packages via drone, drop off urgent shipments in your truck, and become the biggest package pickup place in sunny Cranelock.

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.summary:
The Witch’s Bakery is a 2D Adventure Puzzle game where you play as a joyful witch who opens a bakery in modern Paris.

She has a special power: she can heal emotions with her bread.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary: 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

games.name: CyberPunk Sex Tower
games.summary: The world of the future, modern technologies make it possible to create a super realistic sexual experience ...

games.name: Enshrouded
games.summary: You are Flameborn, last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival Action RPG for up to 16 players.

games.name: FreshWomen: Season 3
games.summary: FreshWomen is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the best parts of life. You're a college freshman who just earned a mansion. Bring girls to your home to romance, date, or fuck them. Your journey will be filled with comedy, love, and lots of sex.

games.name: Frosthaven
games.summary: From the creative mind of Isaac Childres, the highly acclaimed board game moves to the digital realm in the video game adaptation of FROSTHAVEN! The dark fantasy tactical RPG features deep mechanics and challenging yet satisfying gameplay both in Single Player and Co-Op Online Multiplayer.

games.name: Ratatan
games.summary: Ratata Arts and TVT have announced Ratatan, a new rhythm action game from the creator of Patapon previously teased as Project JabberWocky.

games.name: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
games.summary: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings the definitive version of the game inspired by the Academy Award-winning film to modern platforms for the first time, including previously platform-exclusive content from the PlayStation 3 version and an enhanced experience with upgraded visuals, higher resolutions and improved performance. Toy Story 3 is best known for its groundbreaking Toy Box Mode, a massive, open-world sandbox that allowed customization of the environment and characters and featured non-linear missions that allow players to unlock new toys, vehicles and characters from other Pixar movies.

games.name: Solemnfable
games.summary: Fight and forgive in this QTE based RPG, and travel the Earth and stars with those who matter most. SOLEMNFABLE - A journey of acceptance.

games.name: Tales of Eternia: Remastered
games.summary: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: Eternal Blade
games.summary: An open-world action RPG set in the Baransu Realm. Play as Emerald, the last of the Murakai Bloodline and daughter of Sensei Lux, fighting to gather the Almighty Gemstones, wield the Eternal Blade, and free her father from an eternal curse before chaos and darkness are unleashed on the realm.

games.name: Veyrasol
games.summary: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

games.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
games.summary: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game where you and your friends investigate, document, and hunt cryptids in the Appalachian Mountains.

games.name: Bytes and Knights Adventure
games.summary: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale digital TCG set within an RPG world, packed with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets of your new city, collect cards, build your own deck, and battle increasingly challenging opponents. Each new card unlocks new playstyles and brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

games.name: Stupid Never Dies
games.summary:
Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.

Steal enemy abilities, customize your undead body with bizarre upgrades, and experience fast-paced combat packed with innovation.

games.name: The House in the Hollow
games.summary: With stunning graphics, inspired by the 1920's Art Deco period, and a chilling soundtrack, the "House In The Hollow" will take you on a journey like no other. A journey filled with mystery, horror, and magic, where you are the master of your own fate.

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Misdeed, Theft, Abduction, Plunder. This is a tale of “Evil,” where anything goes.
Where the hero is a dull boy named Kyoshiro, who hates the world. And a self-proclaimed evil god having lost his powers appears to him. Team up with the evil god and go beyond the limits of evil! Steal! Abduct! Terminate! Let your evil show!

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixelart world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort
games.summary: Get up and move in 12 motion-control sports! Gently swing your racket, pull back and aim like an archer, and more in 12 sports with intuitive motion controls. Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, and even battle with one thumb in Thumb Wrestling - there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together!

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a first-person shooter and the follow-up to Modern Warfare III (2023), continuing the rebooted Modern Warfare storyline. The campaign is set during a North Korean invasion of South Korea and features dual perspectives: a young South Korean soldier named Private Park facing his first combat deployment, and Captain Price operating outside official channels on a personal mission. The game also includes multiplayer with 6v6 core maps, large-scale vehicle combat maps, and a dynamic map system called Kill Block that reshapes layouts between rounds. A DMZ extraction mode is also featured. The game is released exclusively on current-generation platforms and PC.

games.name: Death Rabbit
games.summary: The city that never sleeps has taken a sinister turn, and the dark tunnels of the MTA have become the epicenter of a horrifying outbreak. As Alisa, you must navigate through a labyrinthine underground world fraught with danger, where unspeakable horrors lurk around every corner.

games.name: One Piece: Grand Gourmet
games.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Snap & Print
games.summary: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

games.name: Breach Signal
games.summary: Breach Signal is a 1-6 Player Co-op Psychological Horror game. Enter a special unit operating for The Agency, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

games.name: Eyes Wide Open
games.summary: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

games.name: Last Floor
games.summary:
Last Floor is a first-person psychological horror game focused on observation and anomaly detection. The player navigates a looping hospital corridor and must identify subtle changes in the environment.

Each run begins in an elevator and progresses through an identical hallway. The player must determine whether an anomaly is present during the loop and choose the correct elevator direction to continue. Incorrect decisions reset progression.

games.name: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
games.summary: Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

games.name: Recycling Shift
games.summary: Work at a recycling facility! In this tactile cozy job simulator, sort discarded items into categories, process them into raw material and sell valuable items for money. Could be trash or treasure! Upgrade your workflow, sort and process efficiently.

games.name: Space Savory
games.summary: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

games.name: The Mailroom
games.summary:
A horror job simulator where you work in the mailroom of a small regional office of Hell located in Modesto, California.

You just started working in the mailroom of that weird building on 5th. The job was easy enough at first. Sort the mail and use their creaky old pneumatic tube system to send it to the correct departments. But then shit started getting weird. Can you figure out what's really going on in this place and find a way out?

games.name: Timeless Rain
games.summary: Explore this foreign world and use manipulate time to defeat any creature who dares to stand between you and your goal! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

games.name: Cozy Archivist Simulator
games.summary:
Cozy Archivist Simulator is a first-person organizing simulation game set in an archive. The player works with piles of document folders, reads filing instructions, and places files on shelves according to archive rules.

The gameplay focuses on sorting and arranging documents by parameters such as category, subcategory, date, number, and other filing criteria. Tasks include processing incoming boxes, finding requested files, checking records, cleaning up workspaces, correcting misplaced documents, and restoring order to archive rooms.

The game features Sandbox Mode with selectable levels and archive tasks, and Campaign Mode structured around a series of working days with different assignments.

games.name: Emberville
games.summary: Help the citizens of Emberville rebuild their town, as you rescue them from the clutches of wicked forces with the aid of a mysterious and loyal friend. Learn various crafting and combat skills as you explore the treacherous corridors of a massive, ever-changing dungeon.

games.name: Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Expansion
games.summary: Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in Catuaí, a South America-inspired region shaped by coffee terraces, red soil and lush hills. Grow coffee beans, raise alpacas and Brahman cows, start new production chains and operate 25+ new machines!

games.name: Minecraft
games.summary: Minecraft focuses on allowing the player to explore, interact with, and modify a dynamically-generated map made of one-cubic-meter-sized blocks. In addition to blocks, the environment features plants, mobs, and items. Some activities in the game include mining for ore, fighting hostile mobs, and crafting new blocks and tools by gathering various resources found in the game. The game's open-ended model allows players to create structures, creations, and artwork on various multiplayer servers or their single-player maps. Other features include redstone circuits for logic computations and remote actions, minecarts and tracks, and a mysterious underworld called the Nether. A designated but completely optional goal of the game is to travel to a dimension called the End, and defeat the ender dragon.

games.name: Pidgeon Pocket
games.summary: Pidgeon Pocket is a chill incremental game about a rooftop pigeon-keeper who sends a flock of trained pigeons into a living city park to pickpocket small valuables from park-goers and bring the loot home. Each round the park transforms into a different live event, from a marathon or a street parade to a market, a concert or a dog show, while an intelligent police force reacts to every theft. Progression runs through a skill tree of abilities and rotating talents, growing the flock from a single pigeon into a full squad. Localized into 30 languages, fully playable with mouse, keyboard or controller, and built to run on Steam Deck.

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.

games.name: Rolling Stock
games.summary: An online co-op train loading game for up to 4 players. Keep an eye out for labels, ensure a tight fit, and help your friends when things get heavy. This new fully physics-based puzzler is rolling out cross-platform on Windows and Linux!

games.name: Thyranya
games.summary:
Thyranya is a free-to-play old-style MMORPG with a vast open world to be explored, dangerous creatures, rewarding quests and a lot of social content!

Dive into a world that pays homage to the classics like Diablo, Tibia, and League of Legends, yet stands out with its unique vibe. Thyranya is more than just a game; it's a blend of nostalgia and innovation, crafted from our passion for those unforgettable late-night gaming marathons. Here, you'll find everything from pixel art magic and epic boss battles to smooth animations, crisp graphics, and a fluid combat system designed for today's gamers. Join us on this journey and experience the essence of gaming, right from our hearts to your screen. Subscribe for a front-row seat to all things Thyranya—where every play feels like coming home, yet embarking on an adventure anew.

games.name: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
games.summary: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

games.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
games.summary: Just in time for the 20th anniversary, You Are Empty has been revitalized for modern systems, with fixes, new features, and QoL additions, including all the official localizations. Our team carefully went through the entire game whilst faithfully preserving the intent of the original release.

games.name: A Dogs Dream
games.summary: Test your sixth sense. Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks? Every choice is yours to make. May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

games.name: Backrooms: Splatter
games.summary: The Backrooms got colorful. Suit up, grab your paint, and splatter your way out of the liminal void with up to 4 friends.

games.name: Copy Cats
games.summary: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

games.name: Fuel Station Simulator
games.summary: Are you ready for the most comprehensive fuel station simulation ever? Manage your fuel station, your shop, the car wash, the workshop, your employees and much more…

games.name: Grimmlins Tale
games.summary: Grimmlins Tale is an action adventure monster tamer where you catch, train, and bond with all fairy tale inspired monsters. Fight alongside your monster friends in deep, real-time strategic combat, and hop on their backs to explore in the whimsical world of Never Everland.

games.name: InOut
games.summary: A minimalist puzzle platformer where each level is more than they seem. Change your perspective on levels to discover new areas. Explore the world to unearth its hidden secrets.

games.name: Anomalith
games.summary: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

games.name: Hello Kitty: Party Land
games.summary: Together with heart.

games.name: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
games.summary: You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

games.name: Phantom Blade 0
games.summary:
Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by his former comrades, he moves through a world of shifting loyalties and silent blades — determined to unravel the conspiracy that has condemned him.

Rain mixes with blood, mercy entangles with vengeance. Soul's journey is one of love, hate, and the fragile search for what it means to have a heart.

games.name: 10 Hours Before Sunrise
games.summary: A brutal 8-bit-style boomer shooter inspired by the best of ‘80s trash horror. You are Samuel Alvarez, a broken man who discovers a cabin worse than any nightmare. Survive the night and face the forces of Wendakor — or you won’t see the dawn.

games.name: Aposis: Infinity Hero
games.summary: Aposis is a minimalist retro JRPG/Roguelike about fighting enemy androids while uncovering the truth about what happened to the world 3,000 years ago.

games.name: Bold: Networked Newt Action
games.summary: Bold: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

games.name: Brain Hack Squad
games.summary: Build and lead your own cybernetic hit squad as you battle rival groups. Use real time tactical combat with pause to direct your cybernetic agents in combat. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants to gain control of the city.

games.name: Fortune x World: Bokura ga Game wo Tsukuru Riyuu
games.summary: Glovety's 3rd project, about game development.

games.name: Goodboy Galaxy
games.summary: A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game for the Game Boy Advance, where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.

games.name: Gray Planet
games.summary: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

games.name: Hauntworks
games.summary: Hauntworks is a dark comedy haunted house management sim where you build an automated scare factory. Your undertakers harvest human reactions like screams, vomit, and laughter as physical resources, which you pipe through production chains to appease otherworldly patrons and escape limbo. Releasing in Early Access Halloween 2026.

games.name: Mad Ever After
games.summary: Happily ever after? Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op roguelike FPS. Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs, combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

games.name: NVA: No Visitors Allowed
games.summary: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

games.name: Prison Legacy
games.summary: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

games.name: Project Reprieve
games.summary: A fast-paced FNaF-inspired roguelike first person sit 'n' survive, beat the demons and sins back and repent for you and your friends sins!

games.name: Ray's Hotel Adventures
games.summary: Use your handy Ghost Catcher to capture ghosts, solve puzzles, and stop the horny ghost girls that have been causing some trouble

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary: Join your favorite Dr. Seuss characters in 18 exciting minigames and challenges. Your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: Through the Manor
games.summary: A cozy building sandbox where you craft painterly structures and step inside them in 3rd person. Build whimsical manors, explore every room you design, and reside within your creations in this atmospheric, stress-free experience.

games.name: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
games.summary: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

games.name: God Is Not Here
games.summary:
God Is Not Here is a first-person psychological horror game. The player explores an isolated house, investigates paranormal phenomena, solves environmental puzzles, and follows clues through recordings, surveillance cameras, and the surrounding environment.

The game focuses on atmosphere, narrative exploration, environmental storytelling, and encounters with hostile supernatural entities.

games.name: Phosphor
games.summary:
Phosphor is a fast-paced sci-fi platformer roguelike where you descend into procedurally generated cyberpunk biomes, battling waves of drones, mechs, and biotech horrors.
Master dynamic combat blending gunfire, melee, dashes, and cyber spells. Stack elemental effects like Burn, Freeze, Shock, and Poison to unleash powerful reactions, then take on massive, pattern-heavy bosses.
Forge devastating builds from hundreds of weapons, passives, and abilities that synergize across runs. Unlock upgrades with persistence cores, tackle daily/weekly challenges, and push deeper with every attempt.
A high-mobility, challenging 2D action game inspired by the intensity of Dead Cells and the emergent chaos of Noita. Currently in active development and beta testing ahead of Steam launch.
Get to the core. The Phosphor still lives.
